name: runtime
description: Runtime operator control plane for agentic-plugins host readiness, doctor diagnostics, settings planning, machine bootstrap lifecycle (ADR-0046: probe, staged plan, rendered fragments, presented installs, proofs, portable machine profiles), workflow storage migration and read-only cross-checkout legacy egress-intent discovery, consensus artifacts, compatibility drift planning, worktree planning, cutover audits, read-only operator dashboard snapshots, context hygiene artifacts and explicit budget checks, ADR-0047 §7 citation-aware artifact retention (read-only plan + explicit dry-run/--execute apply behind plan-hash binding and write-ahead receipts), completion footers, model/effort config, companion readiness, and workflow ledger health. L1 framework primitive per ADR-0024.

interface.shortDescription: Runtime diagnostics, settings planning, machine bootstrap, migration, consensus, compat, worktree, context, and cutover evidence
interface.longDescription: L1 framework primitive per ADR-0024. Provides $runtime:doctor as a read-only diagnostic surface for Claude Code and Codex CLI availability, auth state, marketplace/cache/plugin discovery, companion contract compatibility, model/effort resolution observation, explicit read-only sandbox/permission probe output, and engineer/orchestrator workflow plus peer-run ledger health. Provides $runtime:settings as a dry-run settings planner with explicit --apply writes limited to agentic-plugins-owned .agentic-plugins/config.toml model/effort defaults. Provides $runtime:migrate workflow-storage as an explicit ADR-0025 dry-run/apply surface that moves generated legacy .claude/agentic-* workflow state into .agentic-plugins/state/<plugin> only when blockers are clear, and $runtime:migrate legacy-egress-intents as the ADR-0048 residual (d) READ-ONLY machine-scoped inventory of pre-upgrade repo-scoped egress intent WALs left in other checkouts: it has no --apply, writes nothing, reads no record body, never emits a shell command, spawns no subprocess in the scan itself (the command wrapper resolves the repo root with git rev-parse like every runtime command), excludes the live machine-global WAL by device/inode identity while reporting the current checkout's own legacy directory as a finding annotated already_fenced_by_current_doctor, withholds every removal instruction while the scan is incomplete, and states the irreducible residual that checkouts outside the scanned roots are not covered. Provides $runtime:consensus as a dynamic peer consensus scaffold with an explicit companion executor: plan peer prompts, run companion dispatch only with execute --execute, store raw peer outputs as files, synthesize summary/disagreements/evidence pointers, and plan bounded targeted rebuttal rounds. Provides $runtime:compat as a host-version drift and release-note gap planner for Claude Code / Codex CLI compatibility updates without mutating host state. Provides $runtime:worktree as a read-only planner for isolating non-trivial follow-up slices in dedicated git worktrees without mutating git state. Provides $runtime:context as a runtime-owned context hygiene scaffold that writes bounded summary/risk/next-session artifacts under .agentic-plugins/runs/context and runs read-only explicit budget checks without mutating host session context. Provides $runtime:cutover as a read-only omcc cutover readiness report that aggregates ADR-0012, scorecard, host parity, plugin version, compat, consensus/context, footer, and omcc-dev activity evidence without declaring final cutover. Provides $runtime:dashboard as the ADR-0040 read-only aggregate operator view over three-persona workflow/peer-run state, macro subtask progress, consensus runs, recorded doctor/compat/baseline freshness, settings and Codex hook-attestation recency, artifact attention items, and notify-state health, with a filesystem-only bounded --watch mode that never probes host CLIs. Provides $runtime:bootstrap as the ADR-0046 machine-scoped, artifact-only bootstrap lifecycle: plan a bundle with a live two-host probe and hard-dependency closure, print exact Stage 0 commands for missing hosts or marketplace registrations, render model/effort, notification, egress-launcher, and statusline fragments with backup/verify/manual-revert guidance, present the plugin-management command carrying the plan hash (the settings executor refuses on divergence; bootstrap never executes), resume with live re-probe plus explicit proof recording through runtime:doctor --record, verify recorded proof evidence without running proofs, abandon crashed runs, and export/seed portable secrets-free machine profiles under the machine-global ~/.agentic-plugins home. Provides a script-level completion footer helper for pointer-only workflow handoff. Completion footer mutation, automatic unbounded consensus loops, automatic context mutation/capture triggers, automatic release-note URL fetch, and automatic plugin install/update apply mode are deferred.
